contract.input_layout: [dimension, diagonal_depth, nnz, row_nnz[dimension], perm[dimension], ptr[depth+1], column_index[nnz], value_raw[nnz], vector_raw[dimension]]
contract.row_invariants: row_nnz is nonincreasing and row_nnz[0]=depth; nnz=sum(row_nnz); diagonal length k is count(row_nnz[i]>k); ptr is the prefix sum of those lengths; perm is a permutation of 0..dimension-1.
contract.value_encoding: Matrix values and dense vector values are signed Q1e-6 integers in [-1000000,1000000], converted as binary32(raw)/binary32(1000000).
contract.operation: For each JDS row rank i in ascending order, initialize float32 sum=0, then for k=0..row_nnz[i]-1 use j=ptr[k]+i, round float32(data[j]*x[column[j]]) to binary32, and add/round to sum in source order. Store sum at output[perm[i]].
contract.output_encoding: Little-endian uint32 dimension followed by dimension little-endian IEEE-754 binary32 output values, matching the source output record shape.
contract.source_scope: Preconverted Jagged Diagonal Storage only. COO parsing, symmetric expansion/conversion, 50 repeated benchmark iterations, file I/O, and timing wrappers are excluded.

input.encoding: JDS dimensions and row metadata followed by column indexes and signed Q1e-6 binary32 source values.

output.encoding: Little-endian uint32 dimension followed by dimension IEEE-754 binary32 row results.

workspace.meaning: Maximum-size staged output record; output is copied only after validation and computation succeed.
